candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart creates a group of Marines as combat constructs

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John manifests a squad of Marine constructs to fight with him. This is a tactical/assisted battlefield use of the ring rather than a permanent creation.
candidates.title: Blackest Night Marine squad
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John summons a whole Marine unit that joins the fight against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart fires a sniper-rifle construct into Mogo’s core

claim_citation.quote: John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John builds a precise sniper rifle construct and uses it to deliver the finishing shot that kills Mogo. This is one of his most lethal and technically detailed constructs.
candidates.title: The Mogo sniper shot
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests a sniper rifle, takes aim, and shoots a bullet straight into Mogo’s core.

claim_citation.quote: Fueled by his regret, he was able to temporarily manifest the entire system as a construct in the hopes of bringing it back again.

candidates.summary: Temporary reconstruction case. John’s ring attempt is enormous in scope: he tries to recreate an entire lost solar system/planetary system out of grief and remorse.
candidates.title: Recreating Xanshi’s system
candidates.what_visibly_happens: The construct reaches planetary scale, but it is only a temporary manifestation and does not permanently restore the dead world.

claim_citation.quote: John constructed a green mastodonic construct of himself to fight his Kryptonian ally, pushing his boundaries to the limit.

candidates.summary: Demonstration case. John makes a giant version of himself as a combat construct, but the retrieved source does not name the exact issue, so this remains partially supported.
candidates.title: Giant self-construct
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John turns himself into a towering green construct to brawl with Superman.

claim_citation.quote: In a mind-blowing battle, the former Green Lantern mustered up a giant monster and an army of demons to defeat the protectors of Earth without losing control over his constructs.

candidates.summary: Hypothetical/possession-adjacent case. Under Ultraviolet influence, John weaponizes shame into a massive summoned creature plus multiple demonic constructs.
candidates.title: Ultraviolet monster-and-demons construct set
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John unleashes a giant monster and an army of demons against the Justice League while under Ultraviolet influence.
